title: Building Linux from Scratch Using C Code

lessons.title: A C program meets the host
Plan the toolchain and root filesystem

nextTopics: Next modules: host qualification; an isolated virtual machine; target directories; source checksums; temporary cross-toolchain; sysroot and headers; libraries and dynamic loader; isolated build environment; base utilities; kernel configuration; init and services; bootloader; QEMU boot evidence; package manifests and recovery. Disk installation follows a separately reviewed guide.
readingNote: Read in order. Concepts can be studied without installation; optional programming exercises require the named language tools. Available lessons form an opening module, not a completed course.
